summary: Stable v0.1.0 linux-amd64-clang CLI and toolchain republished as Debian 13 trixie builds, re-signed, and validated end to end on a native Debian 13 amd64 host through the published stable bootstrap.

defect_fixed.description: The previously published v0.1.0 linux-amd64-clang toolchain was a Debian 12 bookworm build that bundled glibc 2.36, libm, libstdc++, libgcc_s, and ICU 72 under System/Library/Libraries despite manifest labels icu_major 76 / glibc_min 2.41. The installed CLI aborted with 'stack smashing detected' on Debian 13 amd64.

release.release_manifest_signature: verified against the production release trust root pinned in scripts/bootstrap (production-bootstrap-trust-root, PR #2)

bootstrap_asset.source: scripts/bootstrap/gnustep-bootstrap.sh at origin/production-bootstrap-trust-root (a023008) with CLI_VERSION stamped to 0.1.0

known_limitations: The full CLI reports version 0.1.0-dev and defaults its update manifest to the v0.1.0-dev prerelease; this is hardcoded in src/full-cli/GSCommandRunner.m and equally true of the stable arm64 CLI.
Binaries built by hand after sourcing GNUstep.sh need <root>/lib on LD_LIBRARY_PATH (libdispatch, libobjc2); the gnustep launcher and gnustep new templates handle this.

The Release run consumed the committed May 2026 linux-smoke-report.json (Debian 12 container against v0.1.0-dev-hosted.32) as its Linux smoke gate input; this file is the fresh Debian 13 amd64 evidence.
Stable arm64 was not exercised through the bootstrap in this validation.
Official amd64 package artifacts on v0.1.0 (arlen, gorm, tools-xctest snapshots from 2026-05-05) were built against the previous bookworm toolchain and were not rebuilt or revalidated.
